title: Threat-Intelligence and Scientific-Characterization Prospective Protocol
purpose: Translate already-frozen AEGIS scientific evidence into explicit threat-intelligence, information-integrity, failure-mode, observability, and operational-claim boundaries without reopening model development.

evidence_policy.primary: Use only already-frozen tracked AEGIS evidence and records.

T1.name: multimodal_threat_surface
T1.question: Which already-established corruption, mismatch, modality-quality, and information-integrity conditions constitute observable threat/failure surfaces in the frozen AEGIS evidence?
T1.output: Evidence-linked taxonomy; no new conditions may be invented as evaluated conditions.

T2.name: evidence_to_operational_signal_mapping
T2.question: Which frozen model quantities can be treated as observables for monitoring or analyst triage?
T2.rule: Availability and support must be established from tracked evidence before any operational claim.

T3.name: failure_mode_localization
T3.question: What failure modes are supported by frozen evidence, and at which layer are they localized?

T4.name: information_integrity_claim_boundary
T4.question: Which claims can AEGIS support for misinformation/disinformation/malinfo/hate or multimodal authenticity/security workflows from current evidence, and which remain future scope?
T4.rule: Do not convert generic classifier/reliability evidence into unsupported content-type attribution.

T5.name: threat_intelligence_alertability
T5.question: Which evidence patterns are potentially alertable versus analyst-context-only?
T5.rule: No production alert threshold is selected in v0.37 Step1.

T6.name: scientific_claim_ledger
T6.question: Create a claim ledger separating SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED, NOT_COMPUTED, NOT_AVAILABLE, and PROHIBITED claims.
T6.rule: Every claim must point to an already-frozen evidence source or be marked unsupported/unavailable.

operational_principles: AEGIS evidence is decision support, not autonomous attribution.
Classifier performance, reliability evidence, selector behavior, and intervention behavior are separate evidence layers.
A failed selector does not imply a non-robust classifier.
Validation performance does not substitute for formal robustness evidence.
Threat-intelligence interpretation must preserve dataset/task/population scope.
No production deployment or national-security operational claim is authorized by this research protocol.
prohibitions: new content-taxonomy performance claims without evidence
reopening v0.35 or v0.36 scientific decisions
